02 / Identity

A familiar orbit. A clearer mark.

The original blue-orbit identity, refined into scalable shapes and font-independent lettering.

Primary / light surfaceSVG + PNG
Reversed / dark surfaceSVG + PNG
One color / navyNo gradients
Stacked / compact placementOutlined wordmark

Keep the mark’s silhouette and open route intact. Use the simplified icon below 40 pixels; reserve full wordmarks for spaces at least 180 pixels wide.

04 / Interface language

Useful detail. Quiet structure.

Native system typography, aligned measurements, and clear interaction states.

Controls & states

Primary action: #2563EB · white text: 5.17:1 contrast

Hover specimenPressed specimen
Selected item · uses text and an edge indicator
Ready Attention Unavailable

Tab through controls to inspect focus. Reduced motion follows the operating-system preference.

Typography & spacing

System sans-serif / 400 · 500 · 600

Readable at every level.

14 px body text. 12 px secondary labels. A 4 px spacing grid with 6–8 px control and panel corners.

12.8 GB / 32 GB

PID 4280   ·   127.0.0.1   ·   42 MB/s

Tabular numerals keep columns steady. Monospace is reserved for technical identifiers.
